Describe the concrete problem and the resulting behavior in complete sentences.

## Changes

Explain the affected build inputs, code, or artifact contract and why the change is needed.

## Validation

Record commands and observed results. Separate metadata checks, maintenance tests, compiler builds,
device execution, and distribution validation. State which relevant checks were not run and why.

## Artifact impact

State whether source revisions, SDK identity, bridge ABI, supported platforms, archive checksums,
size, or measured performance changed. Record new measurements only when they were collected.

## Remaining work

Record limitations or follow-up work that consumers and future reviewers need to know.
